As an important indicator of a company’s financial state, earnings per share are one of the most followed metrics among traders, so the calendar above can serve as a powerful tool for analysis. The calendar is simple but contains all the necessary information — the report’s time and company name, estimated and actual EPS, surprise, and the company’s market capitalization. With buttons on the upper panel, you can customize the calendar — choose a time period, country, and time zone to see only those reports that suit your strategy. Track Tesla's earnings, Amazon's earnings, and even more. Earnings Calendar is a tool to track companies' earnings in a convenient table with key data.
